create.title: Boundary-first architecture for the beta terminal symbol
create.statement_tex: A pointwise terminal K(L,nu) cannot contain radial horizontal sides or explicit endpoint boundary functionals, which live on different contour strata. The accepted architecture is: apply arbitrary-order radial endpoint subtraction and remove only the renormalized sides under nested heights; collapse the explicit endpoint/artificial/arithmetic functional by the finite endpoint Cauchy identity; route the proved lower endpoint, physical upper endpoint, and recombined R1 arithmetic residue to their separate modules; then define the local beta symbol from the endpoint-image-free terminal vertical and connector. The v=0 vector residue and its finite connectors remain separately ledgered. This reduction does not prove mask-compatible transfer or the reduced terminal estimate.
create.next_action: Prove that the beta masks and Cauchy-Green connector commute with the accepted endpoint collapse and axial vector ledger without leaving a boundary ownership defect.

create.title: All-order rho Taylor and cutoff cancellation
create.statement_tex: If G=E1+R1 is represented with identical beta masks, finite domains, endpoint images, stars, diagonal/log subtraction, and residue ownership, then Q=omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1 equals R1 meromorphically. For every compatible directional derivative order k, D^k Q=D^k R1. Hence every artificial rho Laurent/Taylor defect and every omega derivative term cancels to all orders. If ownership differs, the first missing datum is the rho-constant coefficient of E_own=H_G-H_E1-H_R1, followed by its physical L derivative. This is exact algebra and supplies no weighted bound for the remaining kernel.
create.next_action: Use this only after proving identical endpoint, side, mask, and axial ownership. Do not estimate split rho pieces separately.

create.title: Mask-compatible endpoint collapse and axial vector ownership
create.statement_tex: At finite U,V,S, apply the accepted radial endpoint Cauchy identity and finite v-contour displacement to every hierarchical beta mask and Cauchy-Green connector share. Prove that the explicit endpoint/artificial/arithmetic terms recombine exactly into the already-proved lower endpoint, physical upper endpoint, and R1 arithmetic-residue modules, that the renormalized radial sides are removed under their accepted nested-height theorem, and that the v=0 terminal, radial-side, arithmetic, u=0, and joint-corner residues plus finite height connectors are each assigned once. The residual endpoint-free terminal share must have zero rho ownership defect E_own and identical masks/domains for all-order cutoff cancellation. No estimate for the residual terminal symbol is included.
create.next_action: Write the finite mask-by-mask contour identity, including endpoint, radial-side, v=0, u=0, and corner shares, and prove the ownership defect vanishes.

create.title: Axial-subtracted side-collapsed terminal symbol bound
create.statement_tex: After M9-M1-beta-mask-endpoint-axial-compatibility, let K_term_circ(L,nu) be the endpoint-image-free, side-collapsed, omega-recombined beta terminal vertical plus connector after the full v=0 vector residue and corner ledger are extracted and one combined top delta/log term is removed. Prove |K_term_circ(L,nu)| at most X^epsilon lambda^(-2)w(nu) and |partial_L K_term_circ(L,nu)| at most X^epsilon lambda^(-3)w(nu) at fixed physical nu, with w in L1 of polylogarithmic norm, compatible translated endpoint traces, and summable U,V tails. Retain the exact inherited h,D_j,x and external normalization factors. This implies the regular terminal BV target and local q^(-2) by the physical-height finite-section lemma.
create.next_action: After the finite compatibility identity is proved, estimate the axial-regular terminal kernel at fixed physical nu and execute its U,V tail bound.

update.statement_tex: The literal all-inclusive K_complete(L,nu) target is revised: radial horizontal sides and endpoint boundary operators are different contour strata and cannot obey a terminal pointwise symbol bound. First prove the mask-compatible endpoint/axial compatibility identity and route renormalized sides, endpoint images, and arithmetic residues through their accepted modules. Then prove the axial-subtracted side-collapsed terminal symbol bound. Together with the boundary-first architecture, all-order rho cancellation, and physical-height finite-section BV lemma, these composable obligations replace the former one-kernel formulation. The complete beta transition and final sums remain open.

update.next_action: Close the mask-compatible boundary/axial ownership and axial-subtracted terminal symbol. Do not place radial sides or endpoint modules inside a pointwise L,nu kernel.
Complete the boundary-first terminal beta branch, then execute its sums; keep endpoint, arithmetic, axial, and side modules separate.

reject.reason: Terminal verticals, radial horizontal sides, and explicit endpoint operators live on different contour strata. The finite identity adds their integrals but does not identify a common pointwise K(L,nu).

The hard side starts at S^(-1), while the left-edge degree-two capacity is S^(1-2ell) with ell<0, giving growing capacity S^(-2ell). Arbitrary-order subtraction removes only the renormalized side and leaves a separate endpoint operator.
Moving the finite v-line produces terminal, radial-side, arithmetic, u=0, corner, and horizontal-connector shares. Subtracting 1/(b+i nu) locally does not reconcile that vector ledger.
Under identical ownership Q=R1 meromorphically, so cancellation holds to every derivative order; without identical ownership even the rho-constant defect is undefined.

The endpoint Cauchy and physical endpoint/residue modules already own those contributions. Reinsertion risks double counting and imposes a false local lambda-symbol normalization on global boundary polynomials.

no_change.reason: The beta ownership identity, axial-subtracted terminal bound, alpha branch, double-bounded share, and residual corridor remain open.
Round 32 concerns only the M1 beta transition.
No unconditional Gauss-circle estimate is claimed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 32 rejects a type-wrong all-inclusive kernel, proves all-order rho cancellation, and replaces it by boundary-first compatibility plus an axial-subtracted terminal symbol target.
